utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the book club’s still on for Thursday. I’m planning to stop by the library after errands and see if they’ve put out this month’s picks.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, then I’ll ask around after I’m done and see if anyone’s read the new picks yet.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can make it, just send me the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll send you the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, just text me when you know it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the book club is still meeting Thursday, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, Thursday still works for me, as long as we keep it to the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, Thursday at the usual time works for you, then?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the book club. I meant to bring my copy, but I may have left it on the kitchen table again.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries, Oren. I can keep a spare copy here, but let’s get you a bookmark before the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That would help a lot, thanks. I’ll bring the bookmark and try not to forget my copy next time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me which book club meeting you mean? I want to make sure I have the details right.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, the one next Tuesday at the library, I think. Sorry, I might be mixing it up a bit.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, I think that’s the library next Tuesday, right? I just want to make sure before I mark it down.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late - did I miss the part where everyone picked the next book?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Not yet, we’re just deciding now. You’re in time to weigh in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m happy with whatever everyone else thinks, but I’d lean toward something not too long.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the book club.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I can bring my folding chairs and a stack of loaner copies.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, I’ll bring some snacks and help set up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the book club on my mind too. Did you want to meet at the library or at my place?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Let’s do the library, if that works for you. It’ll be easier to keep things quiet and fit around school pickups.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The library works for me. I’ll meet you there and keep an eye on the time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club’s been lively lately - I heard they’re picking the next read tonight.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m in - I’ll swing by tonight and bring a list of good picks.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, I’ll be there tonight too, and we can compare notes before they pick.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what time are we meeting for book club?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Let's meet at 7 o'clock.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll be there at 7.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I think the book club is on for Thursday, and I’ll remind Nell again if needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — I’ll plan on Thursday and wait for your reminder if I need it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Thursday it is — I’ll remind you again if needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Uli. I’ve got the book club notes ready, and I’ll make sure everyone knows the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll see you there. I’ll bring the notes and we’ll have everything ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club's been buzzing lately - I heard they're picking something extra lively this month.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds like a lively pick; I hope they don't choose anything too complicated for a club night.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s the hope, isn’t it? I heard they’re leaning toward something quick to get through, so nobody’s stuck wrestling with it all night.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late, but I’d still like to join the book club talk if there’s room.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, there’s room. Join us and I’ll catch you up on where we left off.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, I’m glad to be here. Catch me up on the last part, and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven't heard much about it yet, but I'd be interested to know what the book club is reading.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Not much yet, just that we’re still deciding. I’ll let you know once we have a title.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, just let me know when they pick one.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, the book club. What’s the plan again?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We’re meeting at the library at 7, and I’ve got the sign-up sheet.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll be there at 7.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard the book club is picking a great one this month. Want me to ask around and see who’s joining?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can ask around and let you know who’s in. Did you want me to check if anyone has a copy too?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the book club. I think I missed whatever changed, so you’ll have to catch me up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries — the only thing that changed was we pushed the meeting to next Thursday at 7, and I can bring you the current book list after that.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — next Thursday at 7 works for me. Thanks, and I’ll look for the book list after that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I just saw the new book club flyer at the market. Are we still doing the mystery novel this week?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I think so. I’ll bring the book and we can see if the mystery novel still has the votes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good to me. I’m curious whether it still wins over the other picks.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d be happy to help with the book club—what are we reading next?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s pick something short and easy to get through. How about a mystery novel?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: A mystery sounds like a good choice to me. Short and easy would help everyone keep up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can make it, but I need to know the time and where we’re meeting so I can plan the trip.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We’re meeting at the library at 7. I’ll send the exact room once I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that works for me. Please send the room once you know it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the book club meets Thursday evening at my place. You should come - I’ll save you a spot.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, I’ll be there Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll see you Thursday then. I’ll have a spot saved for you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can do that, but I’ll need to check the school calendar first so I don’t double-book anything. What time is the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think it’s next Thursday at 7, unless I’m mixing it up with something else.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That should work for me, assuming the school calendar is clear. I’ll check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds lovely, Nell. I can bring a few good options for the next book club pick and keep us on track.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That would be great, Rosa. I’ll look forward to hearing what you pick.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll bring a couple of thoughtful picks and keep us on schedule.
